subject: The channel-strip routing slots' destination menus
question: Do the Send, Group and Input slots name destinations, or only the Output slot?

reverify.command: Scripts/observations/reverify-routing-slot-menu.sh (read-only: run the probe with --slot-prefix and no --select)
reverify.expected: each slot opens at least one AXMenu and reports distinct enabled titles; the Send slot reports zero duplicate titles
reverify.cost: Logic open on a project with a mixer strip; ~2 min for all four slots, nothing is selected

method: The 2026-09-11 probe, aimed at each slot in turn by help-text prefix and run WITHOUT `--select`, so it opens menus and closes them with Escape and selects nothing. A track-header Mute is moved and restored first as the positive control; every run reported it moved, so a silent slot would have been the slot's silence and not the instrument's.

observations.what: the press that opens these menus still returns an error code

conclusion: Every routing slot opens a menu whose enabled items are titled, and the SEND slot — the one this ADR records as naming no destination — offers 275 enabled titles with 275 distinct among them, zero duplicates. That is a better-conditioned menu than the Output slot's 273-of-274. The slot's own AXDescription does name no destination (`send button`), which is what the earlier reading saw; the destinations are in the menu the press opens, exactly as the 2026-09-11 record found for the Output slot. The press returns -25204 throughout and the menus open anyway.
limits: Read-only. No send was assigned, so this says the destinations are ADDRESSABLE by name and nothing about whether selecting one lands — the Output slot needed a separate mutating run to establish that.
The Group slot offers three items because this project defines no groups; on a project with groups that number is different and this says nothing about it.
One strip, one project, one host, en-US. Every title here is a localised string and an implementation must go through AXLocalePolicy.

`Audio Effect` was measured in the same sweep (175 menus, 453 enabled, 164 distinct, 13 duplicates) and is NOT a routing slot; it is recorded here only because the same instrument reached it, and its duplicate count is a warning for whoever addresses plug-ins by title.
